scenarios.name: Day 1 real meeting preparation
scenarios.pass_rule: source-grounded output changes one real preparation action

scenarios.name: cross-session correction
scenarios.pass_rule: a new session uses the correction and does not repeat the old error

scenarios.name: Day 7 repeated use
scenarios.pass_rule: the user voluntarily repeats the same loop and it remains decision-useful

scenarios.name: independent install or recovery
scenarios.pass_rule: a non-developer completes native bootstrap, activation, verification, or isolated recovery from the runbook

scenarios.name: live mainland host round-trip
scenarios.pass_rule: a real supported client completes attach, one brain call, and reconnect
